**Symptoms [लक्षणे] of the Disease [रोग]:**

1. Small spots appear on the leaves first.
2. These become yellow and 3 to 4 mm long and 1 mm wide.
3. Such elongated spots gradually turn brownish in color, blacken, grow, and become elongated-rounded. The length of fully grown spots is 12 to 15 mm and the width is 2.5 to 3 mm.
4. Yellow rings are formed around the fully grown spots.
5. Finally, the spots become ash-colored from the middle and only their edges remain blackish.
6. If the number of spots is high, they cannot be distinguished separately, and such diseased leaves tear, wither, and hang from the plant from the petiole.
7. If the incidence of the disease [रोग] is high and severe, the bananas do not fill out. They ripen prematurely and start falling from the bunch. The flesh of the prematurely ripened fruit turns yellowish and its taste [चव] becomes tart.

**Spread:**

1. The primary spread of this disease [रोग] is caused by the sexual spores of the fungus through the air.
2. Asexual spores are spread by raindrops and strong winds, causing secondary spread.

**Climate [हवामान]:**

Warm and humid weather [वातावरण] is very favorable for the growth [वाढ] of this fungus. In the rainy season, there is intermittent rain and cloudy weather [वातावरण]. Therefore, the incidence/outbreak of this disease [रोग] is most pronounced in the rainy season. The infection [संसर्ग] and growth [वाढ] of this disease [रोग] stop when the cold increases.

**Control:**

This disease [रोग] can be controlled by adopting integrated disease management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] techniques. Disease [रोग] can be controlled by proper cultivation changes, destruction of diseased leaves, and use of appropriate fungicides [बुरशीनाशके].

question: भुईमुगावरील टिक्का रोगासाठी प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय काय आहेत?
answer:
भुईमुगावरील टिक्का रोग (पानांवरील ठिपके) बुरशीजन्य रोग आहे जो पिकाच्या उत्पादनावर मोठा परिणाम करतो. या रोगाचा प्रतिबंध आणि नियंत्रणासाठी खालील उपाय करा:

**पेरणीपूर्व उपाय:**
- बियाणे पेरणीपूर्वी थायरम किंवा कॅप्टन या बुरशीनाशकांपैकी कोणतेही एक २.५ ग्रॅम प्रति १ किलो बियाणे या प्रमाणात लावा.

**रोगाची लक्षणे दिसल्यावर उपाय:**
- रोगाची पहिली लक्षणे दिसताच खालीलपैकी कोणतेही एक बुरशीनाशक फवारणी करा:
  - **१% बोर्डो मिश्रण**
  - **०.२५% मॅन्कोझेब**
  - **०.१% कार्बेन्डाझिम**
- फवारणी १० दिवसांच्या अंतराने एकूण ३ वेळा करा.

**प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय:**
- टिक्का रोगाला प्रतिकारक वाण निवडा. उदाहरणार्थ, गुजरात भुईमुग ३७ (सोराथ गौरव) आणि गुजरात भुईमुग ३८ (सोराथ नवीन) या वाणांमध्ये टिक्का रोगाचा प्रतिकार आहे.
- ट्रायकोडर्मा विरिडे जैविक कीटकनाशकाचा वापर करा, जे बुरशीजन्य रोगांपासून संरक्षण करते.
- रोगाची लक्षणे दिसल्यावर तेबुकोनाझोल २५% फ्लोएबल ५००-७५० मिली प्रति हेक्टर ५०० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारणी करा (१०-१५ मिली प्रति १० लिटर पाणी).
- गंधक ८०% डब्ल्यूपी २.५ ते ५ किलो ७५० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारणी करा किंवा हेक्साकोनाझोल ५% फ्लोएबल १५०० मिली ५०० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारणी करा.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५ आणि डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ**

आपल्याला भुईमुगावरील इतर रोगांबद्दल किंवा या पिकाच्या व्यवस्थापनाबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

Groundnut [भुईमुग] (Peanut)

1. Tikka Disease [रोग] (Early Leaf Spot [पानांवरील ठिपके]): This is a fungal disease [बुरशीजन्य रोग]. Generally, the disease [रोग] appears when the crop [पीक] is one and a half to two months old or later. Symptoms [लक्षणे] of the disease [रोग] are seen on the leaves. Dark brown circular spots develop on the leaves. A yellow ring is found around these spots. When many spots come together, the entire leaf turns brown and falls off. If the disease [रोग] occurs, the pods do not fill. The seeds remain immature, wrinkles are found on the surface of the seeds, and there is a large reduction in production [उत्पादन].

Treat the seeds before sowing [पेरणी]. For this, apply Thiram or Captan at 2.5 grams per 1 kg of seeds. As soon as the primary symptoms [लक्षणे] of the disease [रोग] appear, spray one of the following fungicides [बुरशीनाशके] three times at 10-day intervals: 1% Bordeaux mixture, 0.25% Mancozeb, and 0.1% Carbendazim.

2. Rust [गंज रोग]: This is a fungal disease [बुरशीजन्य रोग]. Symptoms [लक्षणे] of the disease [रोग] are seen on both surfaces of the leaves. This disease [रोग] causes reddish-brown, oblong, lens-shaped pustules on the leaves. A brown powder of fungal spores is formed on these pustules.

As soon as the symptoms [लक्षणे] of the disease [रोग] appear, spray 0.25% Mancozeb fungicide [बुरशीनाशक]. Subsequent sprays should be done at intervals of 15 days, depending on the severity of the disease [रोग]. If this disease [रोग] is present along with Tikka disease [रोग], Mancozeb 0.25% is an effective fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] for both diseases.

3. Terminal Drying [वाळवणे] (Bud Necrosis [कळी कुजणे]): This is a viral disease [विषाणूजन्य रोग]. This disease [रोग] causes the ends of the branches to turn brown and dry [कोरडे], and they dry [कोरडे] from top to bottom. As a result, the branches dry [कोरडे] up partially or completely. If the disease [रोग] is more severe, the entire plant dies.

Diagnosis [निदान]

Diagnosis [निदान] is based on isolation [अलग ठेवणे] and identification of *E. coli* from lesions typical of colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस]. Care must be taken to avoid faecal contamination of samples. Material should be streaked on eosin-methylene blue (EMB) or MacConkey agar, as well as noninhibitory media. A presumptive diagnosis [निदान] of *E. coli* infection [संसर्ग] can be made if most of the colonies are characteristically dark with a metallic sheen on EMB agar and bright pink with a precipitate surrounding the colonies on MacConkey agar. Strains of *E. coli* can be slow or non-lactose fermenters and appear as non-lactose fermenting colonies. Multiplex PCR [पीसीआर] for 6 virulence genes of *E. coli* help to distinguish between commensal and pathogenic isolates.

Treatment [उपचार]

Antimicrobial therapy - as per the antimicrobial sensitivity test - under the supervision of the poultry [कुक्कुट] veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक] along with supportive therapy [सहायक उपचार] will reduce the losses in clinical infection [संसर्ग]. Strict withdrawal period should be followed after administration of antibiotics. Water sanitation and acidification of feed and water helps in prevention [प्रतिबंध].

Control

Proper breeder [संकरक] farm and hatchery [अंडी उबवणूक केंद्र] hygiene [स्वच्छता] and sanitization. Feed hygiene [आहार स्वच्छता] and gut health management [आरोग्य व्यवस्थापन].
```

फळावर पिठ्या ढेकूण आढळल्यास ती फळे गोळा करून नष्ट करा.

question: मुगावरील भुरी रोगाचे व्यवस्थापन कसे करावे?
answer:
मुगावरील भुरी रोगाचे व्यवस्थापन करण्यासाठी खालील उपाय करा:

**भुरी रोगाची लक्षणे:**
भुरी हा बुरशीजन्य रोग आहे जो मुगाच्या पानांवर पांढरे पावडरी ठिपके दिसतात. हा रोग ओलसर आणि ढगाळ हवामानात अधिक वाढतो.

**भुरी रोगाचे व्यवस्थापन:**

1. **प्रतिकारक्षम वाण निवडा:** भुरी रोगास प्रतिकारक्षम वाण जसे की **लम पेसरा ६०७ (LGG 607)** आणि **मालविया जनक्रांती (HUM 27)** वापरा. या वाणांना भुरी रोगास प्रतिकार आहे.

2. **बियाणे प्रक्रिया:** पेरणीपूर्वी बियाण्यांची योग्य प्रक्रिया करा. यामुळे रोगाचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो.

3. **रोगग्रस्त अवशेष नष्ट करा:** पीक काढणीनंतर रोगग्रस्त अवशेष जाळून टाका.

4. **संतुलित खत व्यवस्थापन:** नायट्रोजन खत संतुलित प्रमाणात वापरा. जास्त नायट्रोजन खत वापरल्यास रोगाचा प्रादुर्भाव वाढू शकतो.

5. **वेळेवर पेरणी:** वेळेवर पेरणी करा आणि योग्य अंतर ठेवा.

question: रोपवाटिकेतील 'रोप कोलमडणे' (Damping Off) साठी घरगुती उपाय काय आहेत?
answer:
रोपवाटिकेतील 'रोप कोलमडणे' (रोपमर) हा बुरशीजन्य रोग आहे जो जमिनीत वाढणाऱ्या बुरशीमुळे होतो. याचा प्रादुर्भाव पावसाळ्यात आणि रोपांची गर्दी जास्त असलेल्या रोपवाटिकेमध्ये जिथे पाण्याचा निचरा होत नाही तिथे प्रमुखतः होतो.

**घरगुती उपाय आणि उपचार:**

१. **मातीची उपचारप्रक्रिया (सोलर प्रोसेसिंग):**
   - रोपवाटिकेतील माती उन्हात चांगली वाळवा.
   - माती ओलसर करून गादी घालून उन्हात ठेवा, जेणेकरून बुरशी नष्ट होईल.

२. **बीजप्रक्रिया:**
   - बियाण्यांना लागवडीपूर्वी खालीलपैकी एक बुरशीनाशक लावा:
     - **कार्बेन्डाझिम** १ ग्रॅम किंवा
     - **कॅप्टन** ३ ग्रॅम किंवा
     - **ट्रायकोडर्मा** ४ ग्रॅम प्रति किलो बियाणे
   - बीजप्रक्रिया केल्याने बियाण्यावरून बुरशीचा प्रादुर्भाव टाळता येतो.

३. **मातीमध्ये ट्रायकोडर्मा वापरा:**
   - ट्रायकोडर्मा हा जैविक बुरशीनाशक आहे जो मातीतील बुरशीजन्य रोगांचे नियंत्रण करतो.
   - रोपवाटिकेत ट्रायकोडर्मा मिसळून वापरल्यास रोपमर रोगाचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो.

४. **रोपवाटिकेतील देखभाल:**
   - रोपांची गर्दी कमी ठेवा.
   - पाण्याचा निचरा चांगला राहील याची काळजी घ्या.
   - रोगग्रस्त रोपे लगेच काढून टाका.

Example: Organic [सेंद्रिय] farmers who use vermicompost [गांडूळखत] can maintain high crop productivity [पीक उत्पादकता] while adhering to organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] principles and reducing their carbon footprint [कार्बन पदचाप]. *3.4 Reduced Greenhouse Gas Emissions [हरितगृह वायू उत्सर्जन]* By converting organic [सेंद्रिय] waste into compost [कंपोस्ट], vermi-biotechnology [जैवतंत्रज्ञान] reduces the need for waste incineration or landfilling, both of which generate harmful greenhouse gases [हरितगृह वायू] such as methane and carbon dioxide. Example: Manure [खत] processing [प्रक्रिया] through vermiculture [गांडूळ खत निर्मिती] eliminates the harmful emissions associated with livestock waste [पशुधन कचरा] and reduces the environmental footprint of farming [शेती करणे] operations. *3.5 Enhanced Farm Productivity [शेती उत्पादकता] and Profitability [फायदेशीरता]* The products of vermi-biotechnology [जैवतंत्रज्ञान], such as vermicompost [गांडूळखत] and vermiliquid, have significant market value. Farmers can sell these products to local nurseries, garden centers, and agricultural markets, thus creating an additional revenue stream. Example: Smallholder farmers can diversify their income by selling vermicompost [गांडूळखत] to organic [सेंद्रिय] vegetable growers, landscapers, and gardeners, providing them with an extra source of income. *3.6 Biocontrol [जैविक नियंत्रण] of Diseases* Compost [कंपोस्ट] serves as biologic control for plant diseases [वनस्पती रोग]. Micro organisms present in compost [कंपोस्ट] use different mechanisms in combating their pathogenic counterparts. These include competition for nutrients [पोषक तत्वे], parasitism, predation, antibiotic [प्रतिजैविक] production [उत्पादन], production [उत्पादन] of lytic,\ and other extracellular enzymes or compounds Example: The control of plant wilt [मररोग] and damping-off [रोप सड रोग] diseases was reported to be countered by Bacillus sp. in compost [कंपोस्ट]. ``` ---- **State Fishes and Aquatic Animals of India (English, 2024)** ``` Some of these fishes and aquatic animals are listed as 'Near Threatened' and a few as 'Endangered' as per the latest assessment for the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List of Threatened Species [प्रजाती]. question: गव्हाच्या शेतातील उंदरांचा बंदोबस्त करण्याचा सर्वोत्तम मार्ग कोणता?
answer:
गव्हाच्या शेतातील उंदरांचा बंदोबस्त करण्यासाठी खालील सर्वोत्तम पद्धती वापरा:

**१. विषारी आमिष (बॉइट) वापरा:**
उंदरांच्या जिवंत बिळात किंवा जवळ १० ग्रॅम विषारी आमिष टाका. आमिष तयार करण्यासाठी ३८० ग्रॅम चुरा गहू/ज्वारी/मका + १० मिली खाद्य तेल (भुईमुग अथवा जवस तेल) + १० ग्रॅम झिंक फॉस्फाईड ८०% पावडर एकत्र करा. यापासून १० ग्रॅमचे लहान गोळे बनवा आणि प्लास्टिक पिशवीत भरून बिळात ठेवा. एका गोळ्यसाठी ४० बिळांना पुरेसे असते.

**२. बिळे भरा:**
शेतात उंदरांची बिळे आढळल्यास ती भरून टाका. यामुळे उंदरांना आश्रय नाही मिळता.

**३. खोल नांगरणी करा:**
उन्हाळ्यात जमिनीची खोल नांगरणी करा आणि जमीन उन्हात तापू द्या. यामुळे उंदरांच्या पिल्लांचा नाश होतो.

**४. बांध साफ करा:**
शेताच्या बांधांची छाटणी करा जेणेकरून उंदरांना आश्रय मिळणार नाही.

**५. जागा स्वच्छ ठेवा:**
शेतात कचरा किंवा इतर वस्तू ठेवू नका, ज्यामुळे उंदरांना आश्रय मिळतो.

**६. आमिष वापरताना काळजी:**
विषारी आमिष वापरताना काळजी घ्या, कारण हे अत्यंत विषारी आहे. विषारी आमिष वापरण्यापूर्वी ५-६ दिवस त्या आमिषात विष नसलेले अन्न द्या, जेणेकरून उंदरांना शंका येणार नाही.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ**

आपल्या गव्हाच्या शेतात उंदरांचा प्रादुर्भाव जास्त आहे का? किंवा आपल्याला गव्हाच्या इतर किडींबद्दल माहिती हवी आहे का?

As chickpea [हरभरा] is a Rabi season [रबी हंगाम] crop [पीक], dry [कोरडे] and cold weather [वातावरण] is well-suited. question: हळद लागवडीसाठी दोन रोपांमधील अंतराची सर्वोत्तम पद्धत कोणती?
answer:
हळद लागवडीसाठी दोन रोपांमधील अंतराची योग्य पद्धत खालीलप्रमाणे आहे:

**सरी व वरंबा पद्धत (रिज अँड फरो पद्धत):**
- सरी तयार करताना सरींमध्ये ७५ सेंटीमीटर अंतर ठेवा.
- दोन गाड्यांमध्ये (कंदांमध्ये) ३० सेंटीमीटर अंतर ठेवा.
- सरीच्या दोन्ही बाजूंना गाड्या लावा.

**उंच वाफे पद्धत (ब्रॉड बेड पद्धत):**
- दोन सरींमध्ये १.५ मीटर अंतर ठेवा, म्हणजे दोन सरींमध्ये ९० सेंटीमीटर ते १ मीटर उंच वाफा तयार करा.
- या वाफ्यावर दोन ओळींमध्ये आणि दोन रोपांमध्ये ३० सेंटीमीटर अंतर ठेवा.
- या पद्धतीत जमीन समतल असणे आवश्यक आहे.

**लागवडीचा योग्य काळ:**
- अक्षयत्रितीपासून (एप्रिल अखेर) मे महिन्यापर्यंत हळद लागवड करावी.
- उशीरा लागवड केल्यास उत्पादनावर परिणाम होतो.

**लागवडीपूर्वी जमीन तयार करणे:**
- जमीन २-३ वेळा दोन्ही दिशांनी नांगरून १८ ते २२ सेंटीमीटर खोलीपर्यंत भुसभुशीत करा.
- २५ ते ४० टन चांगले कुजलेले शेणखत प्रति हेक्टर मिसळा.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५**

आपल्याला हळद लागवडीनंतर खत व्यवस्थापन किंवा पाणी देण्याबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

Planting of Turmeric [हळद]: Turmeric [हळद] is planted in two ways. After bunding the field [शेत], first, water is given to the open field [शेत], and after proper soil moisture [मातीचा ओलावा] (wasfa), the sets are planted by loosening the soil [माती] with a small hoe [डवरा] or hand tool. This ensures that the seeds are planted at the correct distance and depth.

In the second method, water is released into the field [शेत] after bunding. Sets are planted along both sides of the furrow [सरी] with the water. In this method, there is a possibility of the sets going deep into the soil [माती] and the distance between the two sets not remaining uniform. This leads to the risk of more seeds being required, gaps occurring, germination [अंकुरण] failure, and sets rotting.

Fertilizer [खत] and Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]: Use plenty of organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते] for turmeric [हळद] crops. According to the type of soil [माती], 25 to 40 tons of well-decomposed farmyard manure [शेणखत] per hectare should be given at the time of pre-cultivation and mixed well into the soil [माती]. Apart from this, 120 kg of nitrogen [नत्र], 60 kg of phosphorus [स्फुरद], and 60 kg of potash per hectare should be given. Of these, the entire amount of phosphorus [स्फुरद] and potash should be given before planting, and the dose [मात्रा] of nitrogen fertilizer [नायट्रोजन खत] should be given in two or three splits after four and a half months. A trench should be dug along the rows of turmeric [हळद], the fertilizer [खत] should be put in it, covered with soil [माती], and then watered. Watering should be stopped one month before harvesting [कापणी] the crop [पीक]. Those who do not need it can harvest [कापणी] turmeric [हळद] in March-April without any loss.
```

question: कांद्याच्या रोपांसाठी गादीवाफा कसा तयार करावा?
answer:
कांद्याच्या रोपांसाठी गादीवाफा तयार करण्याची पद्धत खालीलप्रमाणे आहे:

**गादीवाफा तयार करण्याचे महत्त्व:**
कांद्याच्या रोपवाटिकेसाठी गादीवाफे (उंच केलेले वाफे) तयार करणे अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे आहे कारण यामुळे पाण्याचा निचरा चांगला होतो आणि रोपांची मर रोगाची शक्यता कमी होते.

**गादीवाफा तयार करण्याची पद्धत:**

1. **जमीन तयार करा:** चांगली नांगरणी करून जमीन भुसभुशीत करा.

2. **गादीवाफे उंच करा:** रोपवाटिकेसाठी उंच केलेले वाफे तयार करा. यामुळे पाण्याचा निचरा चांगला होतो.

3. **बीज प्रक्रिया करा:** पेरणीपूर्वी कांद्याच्या बियाण्यांची योग्य प्रक्रिया करा.

4. **पेरणीपूर्वी पाणी द्या:** पेरणीपूर्वी गादीवाफ्यांना पाणी द्या आणि नंतर बियाणे पेरा.

5. **बियाणे पेरा:** बियाणे पातळपणे पेरा आणि त्यानंतर तुषार सिंचन किंवा पाऊस गन वापरा.

6. **रासायनिक खतांचा मर्यादित वापर करा:** गादीवाफ्यांवर जास्त रासायनिक खत वापरू नका.

7. **निवारा जाळी वापरा:** शक्य असल्यास रोपवाटिकेवर निवारा जाळी वापरा.

**स्रोत: एमपीकेव्ही कृषी दर्शनी**

आपल्याला कांद्याच्या रोपवाटिकेतील रोग व्यवस्थापन किंवा लागवडीबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
**Measures for Vegetable Crops in Drought [दुष्काळ] Conditions**

In drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, good market prices are obtained for vegetable crops and farmers get good benefits as vegetable cultivation is very limited due to adverse climate [हवामान] (high temperature [तापमान] and dry [कोरडे] hot air) and water scarcity [पाण्याची कमतरता]. For this, it is important to select the right vegetable crop [पीक] and get quality production [उत्पादन] from it. It is difficult to grow vegetable crops in drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, but some measures can be taken to use less water, e.g. to cultivate some vegetables by using drip and sprinkler irrigation [तुषार सिंचन]. Some important measures for this are as follows.

1. Selecting vegetable crops that require less water e.g. drumstick, hadga, guar and leafy vegetables.
2. Use of soil [माती] cover.
3. Onion [कांदा] Nursery [रोपवाटिका] Management [व्यवस्थापन].

- Onion [कांदा] crop [पीक] nursery [रोपवाटिका] should be prepared on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] should be done before sowing [पेरणी] onion [कांदा] seeds.
- Do not use too much chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Water the nursery [रोपवाटिका] before sowing [पेरणी] the seeds and sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds.
- Sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds thinly and then use a sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन] or rain gun.
- Use shed [निवारा] net on the nursery [रोपवाटिका] if possible.

1. To protect against dry [कोरडे] and hot winds, drumstick crop [पीक] or dense planting of maize [मका] should be done on all four sides of the field [शेत] or around the wind [वारा].
2. Water management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन] through micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] methods (drip or sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन]).
3. Proper balance of chemical and organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते].
4. Selecting varieties with more leaves and protecting flowers and fruits from heat through them.
5. Use of growth [वाढ] regulators (NAA 20 PPM and Boron [बोरॉन] 20 PPM) in flowering and use of transpiration [बाष्पोत्सर्जन] inhibitors on leaves.
6. Integrated management [व्यवस्थापन] of biological and chemical drugs for the protection of diseases and pests from nursery [रोपवाटिका] to fruiting.
7. To reduce the intensity of heat, use a porous plastic mesh (shed [निवारा] net).
8. Proper use of available water - especially ensure even water supply during flowering to fruit harvesting [कापणी] period and that too in the morning, morning or evening and at night (avoid watering in the hot sun).
9. Harvest [कापणी] the fruits preferably in the evening and transport the goods (in the morning) after grading [गटवारी] packaging [पॅकेजिंग].  
    By using the above points in a planned and integrated manner, it will be possible to achieve excellent quality of summer vegetables and to obtain higher yields and summer vegetable cultivation will be more profitable due to the combination of the quality and yield [उत्पादन] of the produce.

**Emergency Crop Management [पीक व्यवस्थापन] for Vegetable Crops in Case of Heavy Rains**
```

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
1. Onion [कांदा]  
    If the seed [बियाणे] of onion [कांदा] crop [पीक] is sown in long flat beds, first take immediate measures to remove water from those beds or to drain the water.  
    If it rains heavily after sowing [पेरणी] the onion [कांदा] seed [बियाणे], spray less amount of insecticide [कीटकनाशक]/fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] in that place. So that there will be no outbreak of insect [कीटक] and fungal diseases. Also, drench the nursery [रोपवाटिका] with fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] (Bavistin 10 gm or M-45, 20 gm per 10 liters) through water.  
    Control weeds [तण] in the nursery [रोपवाटिका] to maintain the vapor phase.  
    Planting of onion [कांदा] crop [पीक] should be done by raised bed [उंच वाफे] or ridge and furrow [सरी व वरंबा] method.  
    If it rains more after onion [कांदा] planting, manage to drain the water out of the beds or ridges.  
    At such times, spray insecticide [कीटकनाशक]/fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] by hand to avoid the outbreak of diseases and pests on the seedlings.  
    While spraying [फवारणी] insecticide [कीटकनाशक]/fungicide [बुरशीनाशक], add sticky substance 10 liters of water + 10 ml of sticky substance.
2. Chili/Brinjal [वांगे]  
    If it rains more, manage to drain the water out of the nursery [रोपवाटिका] or beds in the field [शेत].  
    Control weeds [तण] in the nursery [रोपवाटिका] and keep the air circulating and take care that the vapor phase is maintained.  
    Since the rate of mortality in the nursery [रोपवाटिका] is likely to increase due to heavy rains, drench the nursery [रोपवाटिका] with fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] (Bavistin or M-45).  
    After replanting the brinjal [वांगे]/chili crop [पीक], if it rains heavily, remove water from the field [शेत] or dig channels so that the drainage of water in the soil [माती] will help the soil [माती] to vaporize quickly.  
    To prevent the death of replanted seedlings, drench with one of the fungicides [बुरशीनाशके] Bavistin or M-45.  
    Give the amount of fertilizer [खत] like urea [यूरिया] in the soil [माती].  
    If there is heavy rain and cloudy weather [वातावरण], spray appropriate fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] in appropriate amount as there is a possibility of outbreak of fungal disease [बुरशीजन्य रोग].  
    Foliar fertilize with one of the soluble fertilizers e.g. 15:15:15, 20:20:0, 19:19:19 at the rate of five gm per liter.
```

**Krishi Darshani Dr BSKKV, Dapoli 2025**
```
Agroforestry [कृषिवनशास्त्र]

Forest Nursery [रोपवाटिका]

A forest nursery [रोपवाटिका] is an area where good quality and healthy forest tree seedlings are raised and cared for until they are ready for planting. Seedlings of bamboo [बांबू], *shankasur*, casuarina, Gulmohar [गुलमोहर], *murudsheng*, marking nut, *bahava*, annatto, *khair [खैर]*, drumstick, Australian acacia [खैर], eucalyptus [निलगिरी], *Ramal*, rain tree, amla, soap pod [शेंग], Indian almond [बदाम], *pangara*, *kuda*, *biwla*, asana, tamarind [चिंच], chilar, fever [ताप] nut, *khaya*, Brahmi [ब्राम्ही], kokum [कोकम], *kadukirayat*, adusa, tulsi, *bakul [बकुळ]*, *shivan*, surangi, *Kanchan*, *padal*, bael [बेल], false ashoka [अशोक], arjun, teak [टिक], baheda, acacia [खैर], *magium*, java plum, soapnut [रिठा], Indian sarsaparilla, Harada, serpentine root, *bhend*, *undi*, *gunj*, ashwagandha [अश्वगंधा], *kashid*, curry leaf [कडीपत्ता], *giripushp*, *ranwangi*, ain, Ashoka [अशोक], karanj [करंज], *korada*, putrajiva, *kinjal*, peltophorum, periwinkle [सदाफुली], asparagus [शतावरी], lemongrass, *giripushp* plants, vetiver [वाळा] grass, leadwort, agave, *wavding*, *shevar*, *kalalavi*, agnimantha, small eggplant, noni [नोनी], *narkya* etc. are prepared in forest nursery [रोपवाटिका]. Seedling [रोप] registration [नोंदणी] and information is available on tahrksha.mahaforest.gov.in.
```

**Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth**
```
**Note:**

1. For vegetable crops like Brinjal [वांगे], Tomato [टोमॅटो], Chili, Capsicum [शिमला मिरची], Cauliflower [फुल कोबी], Cabbage [पत्ता कोबी] etc., transplant seedlings 4-5 weeks after seed [बियाणे] planting, and onion [कांदा] seedlings after 40-50 days.
2. Among cauliflower [फुल कोबी], early varieties should be planted in April-May, medium varieties in June-July and late varieties in September-October.

**Chili Crop Protection [पीक संरक्षण] Schedule**

When preparing chili seedlings, first sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds in rows on the raised bed [उंच वाफे]. Make a furrow [सरी] between two rows and apply 10% granular phorate insecticide [कीटकनाशक] at 70 grams per sq. meter. Cover the seed [बियाणे] and insecticide [कीटकनाशक] with a light [प्रकाश] layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] of soil [माती]. After the seedling [रोप] prepared in this way has six leaves, plant it in the field [शेत].

If phorate is not used in the nursery [रोपवाटिका], spray dimethoate 30% EC @ 10 ml mixed in 10 liters of water 15 and 30 days after seed germination [बियाणे अंकुरण].
```

question: डाळिंबाला फुलधारणा काळात पाण्याची गरज किती असते?
answer:
डाळिंबाच्या फुलधारणा काळात पाण्याची गरज फार महत्त्वाची असते कारण या वेळी फळांची गुणवत्ता आणि उत्पादन निश्चित होते.

**फुलधारणा काळातील पाणी व्यवस्थापन:**

**ठिबक सिंचन पद्धतीसाठी:**
- फुलधारणा काळात पाण्याची योग्य व्यवस्था करणे आवश्यक आहे. या काळात पाण्याची कमतरता असल्यास फळांची गुणवत्ता कमी होते आणि उत्पादनात घट येते.
- फुलधारणा काळात पाण्याची आवश्यकता जास्त असते कारण या वेळी झाडाची वाढ आणि फळांची विकास होत असतो.

**पाण्याची गरज (ठिबक सिंचन, ४.५ x ३ मीटर लागवड, २०% ओलावा):**

| महिना | पाण्याची गरज (लिटर/दिवस/झाड) |
|-------|----------------------------|
| जानेवारी | ५.८६ |
| फेब्रुवारी | ७.६७ |
| मार्च | ११.३० |
| एप्रिल | १४.३१ |
| मे | १६.२२ |

**महत्त्वाच्या सूचना:**
- फुलधारणा काळात नियमित पाणी द्या, पण जास्त पाणी देऊ नका कारण त्यामुळे मुळांच्या आजूबाजूच्या भागात ओलावा जास्त राहतो आणि मररोगाचा प्रादुर्भाव वाढतो.
- ठिबक सिंचन पद्धतीने एका झाडासाठी लागणाऱ्या पाण्याचे प्रमाण आणि ड्रिपर्सची संख्या ठरवा.
- फुलधारणा काळात झाडांच्या वयानुसार आणि वाढीनुसार पाण्याची मात्रा ठरवा.

**स्रोत: MPKV कृषी दर्शनी**

आपल्या डाळिंब बागेत ठिबक सिंचन व्यवस्था आहे का? किंवा आपल्याला फुलधारणा काळातील खत व्यवस्थापनाबद्दल माहिती हवी आहे का?

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
**Crop Water Requirement [पिकाची पाण्याची गरज] and Drip System Operation Period Through Drip Irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] Method**

The method of calculating the water requirement of crops is different for fruit trees (i.e. when the distance between two trees and the distance between two rows of trees is high, e.g. pomegranate [डाळिंब], lemon [लिंबू], mango [आंबा], etc.) and for crops taken in rows (when the distance between two plants and the distance between two rows of plants is low, e.g. vegetables, crops, sugarcane [ऊस], etc.). While watering fruit trees, moisture has to be maintained in the efficient area of the roots. To calculate the water to be given to one tree by the drip system for this moisture, then the number of drippers required for one tree has to be determined according to the type of soil [माती] and then the period of operation of the system has to be calculated. As the distance between two plants is less for crops taken in rows, the entire row of a specific width has to be kept moist [ओले], so it has to be decided how much distance should be between two drippers as per the type of soil [माती] so that the entire row remains moist [ओले]. Then calculate the water to be given from one dripper as per the water requirement of the crop [पीक] and then determine the operating period of the system. In short, the number of drippers should be calculated to keep the entire area of the efficient root moist [ओले] for watering one tree for fruit trees, while the distance between the two drippers should be calculated for keeping the entire row of the crop [पीक] moist [ओले] for crops taken in rows.

1. **Water Requirement of Crops for Fruit Trees:** The water requirement of the crop [पीक] depends on the climate [हवामान] and season, crop [पीक] and stage of crop [पीक] growth [वाढ]. Also, water is given only to the area where the efficient area of the roots is spread through the drip irrigation system [ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली] without giving water to the entire area. The following formula has been determined for fruit trees considering all these factors while calculating the water requirement of the crop [पीक].

Water required for the crop [पीक] (liter/day/tree) = a x b x c x d

a = Evaporation of water from the soil [माती] (mm/day) b = Crop coefficient [पीक गुणांक]

c = Irrigation [सिंचन] coefficient d = Area covered by trees (sq. meters, m X m)

The information of the various components used in the above formula should be extracted as follows.
```

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
1. Purchase saplings only from a reliable government approved nursery [रोपवाटिका]. Make sure that the mother tree orchard is free from oily spots/wilt disease [मररोग] and that the nursery [रोपवाटिका] has been inspected by experts.
2. Pomegranate [डाळिंब] should be planted only at a distance of 4.5 x 3.0 meters (15.0 x 10.0 feet) Avoid planting pomegranate [डाळिंब] at a shorter distance than this, because in such orchards, the rate of both oily spot disease [रोग] and wilt disease [मररोग] increases rapidly.
3. The first bahar should be retained approximately two years after planting the saplings, before that, retaining bahar makes the plants weak and susceptible to diseases early.
4. For higher economic benefit, in pomegranate [डाळिंब] planted at a distance of 4.5 x 3.0 m, it is appropriate that 20% area near the tree is under irrigation [सिंचन] by drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन]. If more area than that is under irrigation [सिंचन], a microclimate [सूक्ष्म हवामान] is created in the orchard which increases the incidence of short hole borer and wilt disease [मररोग].
5. In areas where stem borer [खोड किउा] infestation is high, it is appropriate to train pomegranate [डाळिंब] with four stems in light soil [हलकी माती].
6. To get quality fruit production [उत्पादन] in pomegranate [डाळिंब], while doing bahar management [व्यवस्थापन], it is recommended to prune [आलूबुखारा] the outer branches at a distance of 20 cm from the tip after leaf fall and to thin out the inner branches so that plenty of sunlight reaches the central part.
7. Retain only one bahar in a year. After retaining bahar, keep the fruits controlled according to the size and age of the tree. This increases the size of the fruits and enables quality fruit production [उत्पादन].
8. The use of micronutrients [सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] and biofertilizers [जैव खते] has been found to be beneficial for quality oriented production [उत्पादन].
9. If natural leaf fall does not occur, it is recommended to spray the plant growth regulator [वाढ नियंत्रक] Ethrel 2 ml per liter 20 days before bahar retention to cause leaf fall.
10. Put fertilizers near the tree by making a furrow [सरी] or under the dripper and cover it with soil [माती].
11. If it is not possible to give water through drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन], give water with the help of canal every 8 to 10 days in summer, 13 to 14 days in monsoon [पावसाळा] (when there is no rain) and 17 to 18 days in winter.
```

### Plant Protection [वनस्पती संरक्षण]

#### Agril. Entomology

36. Bagging of fruits with the polypropylene cloth bags (6x4") at 120 days after bahar is recommended for the prevention [प्रतिबंध] of fruit sucking moth at late ambia bahar on pomegranate [डाळिंब].

38. Soil [माती] application of granular insecticide [कीटकनाशक] fipronil 40% + imidacloprid 40% WG @ 437.5 g/ha along the side of ridge [वरंबा] in the month of June is recommended for the control of white grub in sugarcane [ऊस].

#### Plant Pathology [वनस्पती रोगशास्त्र] and Agri. Microbiology

39. Seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] to gram [हरभरा] seeds with MPKV consortium (Rhizobium [रायझोबियम], phosphate solubilizing and potash mobilizing bacteria [पालाश उपलब्ध करून देणारे जीवाणू]) @ 25 g/kg seed [बियाणे] and application of 75% recommended dose [मात्रा] of N, P and K chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] is recommended for higher grain [धान्य] yield [उत्पादन] and saving 25% of recommended dose [मात्रा] of chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते].

question: उसासोबत घेता येणारी आंतरपिके सुचवा.
answer:
उसासोबत घेता येणारी आंतरपिके खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत:

**सुरू ऊसासोबत (हंगामी ऊस):**
- **भुईमुग:** उसाच्या वरंब्यांच्या दोन्ही बाजूंना १० सें.मी. अंतरावर पेरणी करावी. उसाची लागवड झाल्यानंतर एक आठवड्याने पेरणी करावी.
- **भेंडी (लेडी फिंगर):** जोड ओळी पद्धतीने (९०-१८० x १५ सें.मी.) तुषार सिंचन प्रणालीखाली घेतल्यास उत्पादन व नफा वाढतो.
- **गवार:** आंतरपिक म्हणून घेतल्यास चांगला नफा मिळतो.
- **चवळी:** आंतरपिक म्हणून घेतल्यास चांगला नफा मिळतो.
- **मुळा, राजगिरा, काकडी, कोथिंबीर:** या अल्पकालीन पिकांची आंतरपीक पद्धत वापरल्यास उसाच्या उत्पादनावर कोणताही विपरीत परिणाम होत नाही.

**प्री-सीझनल ऊसासोबत (पूर्वहंगामी ऊस):**
- **बटाटा:** १:१ पद्धतीने ऊस आणि बटाट्याचे आंतरपीक घेतल्यास जास्त उत्पादन आणि नफा मिळतो.
- **पत्ता कोबी:** १:१ पद्धतीने ऊस आणि पत्ता कोबीचे आंतरपीक घेतल्यास जास्त उत्पादन आणि नफा मिळतो.
- **कांदा:** आंतरपिक म्हणून घेतल्यास चांगला नफा मिळतो.

**मका-ऊस आंतरपीक पद्धत:**
- ऊसाची लागवड ६० सें.मी. x ६० सें.मी. - १२० सें.मी. अंतरावर जोड ओळी पद्धतीने करावी.
- दोन जोड ओळींमध्ये दोन ओळी मका पिकाची लागवड ४५ सें.मी. अंतरावर करावी.

**लाभ:**
- आंतरपिक घेतल्याने जमिनीचा पूर्ण वापर होतो आणि एकाच वेळी दोन पिकांचा नफा मिळतो.
- उसाच्या उत्पादनावर कोणताही विपरीत परिणाम होत नाही.

**स्रोत: MPKV राहुरी, कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली**

आपल्या शेतात कोणते आंतरपीक घेण्याचा विचार करत आहात? त्याबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी असल्यास विचारा.

E.g.: Coconut [नारळ], Sapota [चिक्कू], Fig [अंजीर], Guava [पेरू], Java Plum, etc. However, saline and alkaline soils are not suitable for Sweet Orange [संत्रा], Mandarin [संत्री] Orange [संत्री], and Lime [चुना]. The total amount of salts in the soil [माती] should not exceed 2 to 3 m.eq/cm. The amount of free lime [चुना] in the soil [माती] should not exceed 10% or the amount of available lime [चुना] should not exceed 5%. To get a complete idea of the chemical properties, it is important to get the soil [माती] tested from the laboratory before planting fruit trees and take advice from experts. Physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] properties include many things. Water table [पाण्याची पातळी] in the subsoil, soil [माती] depth, amount and type of rock in the topsoil, etc. The water table [पाण्याची पातळी] in the subsoil should be below 3 meters. This level should be fairly stable. The water level should not rise too high during the rainy season and rot the roots. The depth of the soil [माती] should be approximately 1-2 m. Especially for Mango [आंबा], Tamarind [चिंच], Wood Apple [कवठ], etc., it is very important to have greater soil [माती] depth. If the soil [माती] depth is low, shallow-rooted fruit trees such as Papaya [पपई], Banana [केळी], Coconut [नारळ], Grapes [द्राक्ष], etc. can be planted. There should be no hard rock up to two meters deep in the topsoil. Since the roots of fruit trees go deep, trees up to 6 to 10 years of age grow well in such soil [माती]; but later, due to lack of drainage and stunted root growth [वाढ], these trees die.

## Salient research achievements
- Technology for use of paclobutrazol in inducing flowering in mango [आंबा]: Technology has been refined in terms of application schedule, best doses as per the orchard requirement for increasing productivity and without harming the plant health [वनस्पती आरोग्य]. The effectiveness of different doses ( 2-10  a.i. per tree) of PBZ for promoting the flowering and fruiting in mango [आंबा] cv Dashehari was evaluated and was found to be very effective for increasing the mango [आंबा] yield [उत्पादन] ( 25 to 60 % ), besides controlling the biennial bearing habit in mango [आंबा]. Residual influence of paclobutrazol in soil [माती] on fruit yield [उत्पादन] was observed if applied continuously for two consecutive years. The dissipation rate in soil [माती] followed first-order kinetics with half-life values ranging between 57.75 to 77.00 days.
There was an altered community composition of the rhizospheric microbiome due to PBZ treatment [उपचार].
The cost-effective recommendation of PBZ application is 4.0 g a.i./tree in soil [माती] in the first year and a half dose [मात्रा] ( 2 / tree) in the subsequent year due to its long persistency and needs to be integrated with good management [व्यवस्थापन] practices.

question: गव्हाला पहिले पाणी कधी द्यावे?
answer:
गव्हाला पहिले पाणी पेरणीनंतर २० ते २२ दिवसांनी द्यावे. हे पहिले पाणी अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे आहे कारण या वेळी पिकाची वाढ चांगली होते.

जर फक्त एकच पाणी देणे शक्य असेल, तर पेरणीनंतर ४० ते ४२ दिवसांनी द्यावे. दोन पाण्यांची सोय असल्यास, पहिले पाणी २०-२२ दिवसांनी आणि दुसरे पाणी ६०-६५ दिवसांनी द्यावे.

पाणी देताना शेतातील माती ओलसर असल्याची खात्री करा आणि तणनाशक फवारणी केल्यानंतर १०-१२ दिवस पाणी देऊ नका.

question: टरबूज पिकात जास्तीत जास्त फुले लागण्यासाठी काय करावे?
answer:
टरबूज पिकात जास्तीत जास्त फुले लागण्यासाठी खालील गोष्टींची काळजी घ्या:

**१. योग्य खत व्यवस्थापन:**
टरबूज पिकासाठी प्रति हेक्टर १५ टन शेणखत, १५० किलो नत्र, ५० किलो स्फुरद आणि ५० किलो पालाश द्या. यामुळे फुलांची संख्या वाढते आणि चांगले उत्पादन मिळते.

**२. पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन:**
फुले येण्याच्या वेळी (४५ ते ५० दिवसांनी) आणि फळे भरण्याच्या वेळी पिकाला पुरेसे पाणी द्या. पाण्याचा ताण पडू देऊ नका, कारण त्यामुळे फुलांची संख्या कमी होते.

**३. ठिबक सिंचनाचा वापर:**
ठिबक सिंचनाचा वापर केल्यास पाण्याची बचत होते आणि फुलांची वाढ चांगली होते. यामुळे उत्पादनात १५% वाढ होते.

**४. प्लास्टिक मल्चचा वापर:**
पिकाभोवती काळ्या रंगाचे प्लास्टिक मल्च (२५ मायक्रॉन) वापरल्यास तणांचे नियंत्रण होते आणि उत्पादनात १५% वाढ होते.

**५. फुलांची संख्या वाढवण्यासाठी उपाय:**
फुले येण्याच्या वेळी नायट्रोजनयुक्त खते (१९-१९-१९ किंवा २०-२०-२०) १.० ते १.५% (१०० ते १५० ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर पाणी) या प्रमाणात द्या. यामुळे फुलांची संख्या वाढते आणि फुलगळ कमी होते.

**६. फुलांची वाढ व्यवस्थापन:**
फुलांची वाढ होत असताना वेळेवर फवारणी करा आणि फुलांना उष्णतेपासून संरक्षण द्या. गरज असल्यास बोरॉन २० पीपीएम वापरा.

question: द्राक्ष छाटणीची योग्य पद्धत कोणती आहे?
answer:
द्राक्षाच्या छाटणीची योग्य पद्धत खालीलप्रमाणे आहे:

**एप्रिल छाटणी (बॅक प्रूनिंग):**
एप्रिलमध्ये छाटणी केल्याने वेलांवरील कळ्यांमध्ये सूक्ष्म घड तयार होतात. एप्रिल छाटणीनंतर आवश्यकतेनुसार ७ पानांवर सबकेन करा.

**ऑक्टोबर छाटणी:**
ऑक्टोबर छाटणी द्राक्षाच्या फळ फांद्यांवरून घड येण्यासाठी आवश्यक आहे. द्राक्षाच्या वेलीवर प्रति वेल ३५ ते ४० फांद्या ठेवाव्यात आणि प्रति फांदी १५ ते १६ पाने ठेवावीत.

**शरद सिडलस जातीसाठी छाटणी:**
हवामान बदलाच्या दृष्टीने जास्त उत्पादन आणि आर्थिक फायद्यासाठी शरद सिडलस जातीच्या द्राक्षांची छाटणी सप्टेंबरच्या दुसऱ्या पंधरवड्यापासून ऑक्टोबरच्या पहिल्या पंधरवड्यापर्यंत ६-८ डोळ्यांवर करावी.

**छाटणीनंतरची काळजी:**
छाटणीनंतर तांबे ऑक्सीक्लोराइड ०.४% + गम ३ किलो प्रति १० लिटर पाणी किंवा १०% बोर्डो पेस्ट + १५ मिली स्टिकर प्रति १० लिटर पाणी वेली आणि खोडांवर लावावे. छाटणीनंतर वेलीवरील आणि खोडावरील सैल साल काढून टाकावी.

**प्रशिक्षण पद्धत:**
मंडप पद्धत किंवा Y पद्धत अवलंबावी.

**खत व्यवस्थापन:**
द्राक्षाच्या लागवडीनंतर एकरी २६६ किलो नत्र (५८० किलो युरिया), ३५५ किलो स्फुरद (६२० किलो सिंगल सुपर फॉस्फेट) आणि २६६ किलो पालाश (४४५ ग्रॅम म्युरिएट ऑफ पोटॅश) द्यावे. बॅक प्रूनिंगनंतर ७०% नत्र, ५०% स्फुरद आणि ३०% पालाश वेगवेगळ्या प्रमाणात द्यावे.

**स्रोत: एमपीकेव्ही कृषी दर्शनी**

answer:
कोरडवाहू शेतीसाठी बाजरीचे निवडक वाण खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत:

**मुख्य शिफारस केलेली वाण:**

**खरीप हंगामासाठी:**
- **पीसी-७०१ (PC-701)** - ही उत्तम उत्पादन देणारी वाण आहे जी कोरडवाहू शेतीसाठी योग्य आहे.
- **एमपीएमएच-१७ (MPMH-17)** - ही वाण दुष्काळप्रवण भागांसाठी विशेष शिफारस केली जाते.
- **एचएचबी-६७ (HHB-67)** - ही वाण उत्तम उत्पादन देते आणि कोरडवाहू परिस्थितीत चांगली वाढते.
- **८६एम९४ (86M94)** - ही वाण दुष्काळप्रवण भागात चांगले उत्पादन देते.
- **पूसा-१८०३ (Pusa-1803)** - ही वाण कोरडवाहू शेतीसाठी योग्य आहे.
- **प्रोएग्रो ९००१ (ProAgro 9001)** - ही वाण उत्तम उत्पादन देते.

**आंतरपीक पद्धती:**
कोरडवाहू शेतीमध्ये बाजरीच्या आंतरपीक पद्धती फायदेशीर आहेत. हलक्या जमिनीत बाजरी + मटकी आंतरपीक घ्या, तर मध्यम जमिनीत बाजरी + तूर (२:१ प्रमाणात) आंतरपीक घ्या.

**पेरणीचा काळ:**
खरीप हंगामात जुलैच्या पहिल्या आठवड्यात बाजरीची पेरणी करावी.

**घड कापणीसाठी तयार आहे हे कसे ओळखावे:**

केळीच्या फुलांनंतर साधारण १०० ते १२० दिवसांनी घड कापणीसाठी तयार होतो. घड कापणीसाठी तयार आहे हे ओळखण्यासाठी खालील लक्षणे पहा:

- घडावरील केळ्यांचे रंग पिवळसर आणि एकसारखे दिसू लागतात.
- केळ्यांची टोके थोडी वाकलेली दिसतात.
- केळ्यांचे आकार एकसारखे आणि पूर्ण विकसित झालेले दिसतात.
- घडावरील पाने पिवळी पडू लागतात.
- केळ्यांची स्वाद चांगला आणि समाधानकारक होतो.

Propagation [प्रजनन] of banana [केळी] is practiced from secondary seedlings having sword-like blades or from tissue cultured plants. The time required to produce plants of the desired varieties during seedling [रोप] propagation [प्रजनन] is much more than the time required for the production [उत्पादन] of tissue cultured plants. Tissue culture [ऊती संवर्धन] technology is of great importance for producing less time and large number of plants of the desired varieties.

Tissue cultured plant production [उत्पादन] has various stages from laboratory to field [शेत] planting and they are characteristic.

**Advantages [फायदे] of Tissue Culture [ऊती संवर्धन] in Banana [केळी] Crop [पीक]:**

1. The plants take root faster than rhizome [कंद] planting.
2. The plant grows uniformly and evenly.
3. Since the age of the plants is the same, they flower and are harvested almost at the same time.
4. The bunches are ready for harvest [कापणी] one to one and a half months earlier than the rhizome [कंद] planting.
5. The proportion of sterile plants is less than that of rhizome [कंद] planting.
6. The plants are free from fungal, bacterial and viral diseases as well as nematodes / insects (rhizome [कंद] borer).
7. The overall growth [वाढ] of tissue cultured plants is better and more than that of rhizome [कंद] planting.
8. Plants of the desired species [प्रजाती] / varieties are available throughout the year in the desired quantity as per choice.
9. Good quality bananas (exportable) can be produced.
10. Since it is harvested at the same time, post-harvest [कापणी] operations like grading [गटवारी], processing [प्रक्रिया], packing become easier. It is possible to send bananas from the same place to the market.
11. Responds to ratoon cropping system [पीक प्रणाली], so one main crop [पीक] and one ratoon crop [खोडवा पीक] can be taken. Also, the cost of propagation [प्रजनन] and planting per crop [पीक] is reduced.
12. Since the harvesting [कापणी] time can be determined reliably in advance, a profitable planting time can be determined by considering the market price [बाजार भाव].
13. It is possible to produce and multiply new plants as soon as possible.
14. Popular and versatile varieties can be propagated rapidly.

**Tissue Culture [ऊती संवर्धन] for Banana [केळी]**

Banana [केळी] cultivation is mainly done by planting corms or suckers. Since corms are cheap, the cost is lower. However, there are some disadvantages of this cultivation:

1. Planting corms that are often infected with diseases causes diseases in the crop [पीक] and reduces yields.
2. Planting corms of different sizes, different ages/vigors causes uneven growth [वाढ] of plants and extends the harvesting [कापणी] period from 12-13 months to 18-19 months, increasing the cost. Smaller plants do not grow vigorously due to the population of larger plants and this increases the number of sterile plants. This leads to reduced yields.
3. Good quality suckers of suitable varieties are not available for planting at the right time throughout the year.

If disease [रोग]-free plants of the same age prepared by tissue culture [ऊती संवर्धन] are planted, the crop [पीक] will be healthy and vigorous, and the cost will be reduced due to simultaneous and early harvesting [कापणी]. The most important difficulty in planting banana [केळी] plants prepared by tissue culture [ऊती संवर्धन] is the higher cost required for the plants. question: पपईमध्ये आच्छादन (Mulching) करण्याचे फायदे काय आहेत?
answer:
पपई पिकामध्ये आच्छादन (मल्चिंग) करण्याचे अनेक महत्त्वाचे फायदे आहेत:

**१. पाण्याची बचत होते** – आच्छादन केल्यामुळे मातीतील ओलावा टिकून राहतो आणि पाण्याचा बाष्पीभवन कमी होतो. त्यामुळे पपई पिकाच्या पाण्याची गरज २० ते ३० टक्क्यांनी कमी होते.

**२. तणांचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो** – आच्छादन केल्यामुळे तणांची वाढ थांबते आणि तण काढण्याचा खर्च आणि मेहनत कमी होते. त्यामुळे शेत तणमुक्त राहते.

**३. मातीची सुपीकता वाढते** – सेंद्रिय आच्छादन (खुंट, गवत, पालापाचोळा) कुजल्यावर पिकांना पोषक तत्वे उपलब्ध होतात. त्यामुळे मातीची शारीरिक, जैविक आणि रासायनिक सुपीकता वाढते.

**४. उत्पादन वाढते** – संशोधनानुसार, पपईसारख्या फळपिकांमध्ये आच्छादन केल्याने उत्पादन २५ ते ४२ टक्क्यांनी वाढते. आच्छादनामुळे पिक जोमदार वाढते आणि फळधारणा चांगली होते.

**५. जमिनीची धूप कमी होते** – आच्छादन केल्यामुळे मातीची धूप कमी होते आणि मातीचा गुणवत्ता टिकून राहतो.

**६. मातीतील तापमान कमी होते** – आच्छादन केल्याने मातीतील तापमान कमी राहते, ज्यामुळे सूक्ष्मजीवांची संख्या वाढते आणि पिकांना चांगली वाढ होते.

**७. पाण्याच्या अंतर वाढते** – आच्छादन केल्याने दोन पाण्याच्या अंतर वाढते, ज्यामुळे पाण्याची बचत होते.

**८. रोपमर कमी होते** – आच्छादन केल्याने पपईच्या रोपांची मर (रॉपिंग ऑफ) ६०-७५ टक्क्यांनी कमी होते.

**आच्छादनाचे प्रकार:**
- **सेंद्रिय आच्छादन:** खुंट, गवत, पालापाचोळा, कचरा इत्यादी.
- **अजैविक आच्छादन:** प्लास्टिक आच्छादन (काळे, पांढरे, निळे, लाल इत्यादी). फळपिकांसाठी ५०-१०० मायक्रॉन जाडीचे प्लास्टिक आच्छादन वापरावे.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ आणि कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली**

आपल्या शेतात पपईच्या झाडांसाठी कोणत्या प्रकारचे आच्छादन वापरायचे याबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

Through this, a square of 15 cm distance of rice [बासमती तांदूळ] hills is formed and the distance between the two rows transversely and vertically remains 25 cm.
4. Use of Urea [यूरिया], DAP Briquettes: A briquette of 2.7 grams weight is made from a mixture of 60% urea [यूरिया] and 40% DAP with the help of a briquetting machine. One briquette should be planted in the corner of each plant 5-6 cm deep on the second day after transplanting [पुनर्लागवड]. This requires 170 kg of briquettes per hectare and through this 56 kg nitrogen [नत्र] plus 29 kg phosphorus [स्फुरद] per hectare is applied to the crop [पीक]. This saves 40% of fertilizer [खत] consumption. This increases sustainable production [उत्पादन] by 20-30 percent per hectare. Also, the incidence of diseases and pests is less.

- Transplant rice [बासमती तांदूळ] seedlings in rows at a distance of 20 cm x 15 cm.
- Place two to three seedlings straight and shallow in each hill. Leave an open space of 30 cm after ten rows or two meters (leave a strip).

No-Till Cultivation Technology for Rabi Crops [रब्बी पिके] in Konkan

No-till cultivation means planting the crop [पीक] by digging the soil [माती] just enough for sowing [पेरणी] without any special cultivation. However, in this method, weed control [तण नियंत्रण], seed sowing [बियाणे पेरणी] and fertilizer application [खत देणे] are essential. Using such methods for crop [पीक] cultivation has the following advantages [फायदे].

- 1. The available moisture in the soil [माती] lasts longer.
- 2. The cost of cultivation [लागवडीचा खर्च] is reduced. This increases net profit [नफा].
- 3. The infestation of weeds [तण] is reduced.
- 4. Less labour is required. This saves on input costs.

- 5. Since moisture is retained in the soil [माती], crops like pulses can be taken on such residual moisture [अवशिष्ट आर्द्रता].
- 6. If crops are to be taken under irrigation [सिंचन], 50 per cent of water is saved.
- 7. Water saving increases the area under irrigation [सिंचन].
- 8. Sowing [पेरणी] can be done on time as the cultivation time is saved.
- 9. Germination [अंकुरण] is good as the seeds get plenty of moisture.

Selection of Crops for No-Till Cultivation: For this type of cultivation, select crops that require less water. In addition, select crops that are planted by making furrows. The following crops are mainly included in this. Pulse [डाळ] Crops: Wal, cowpea [चवळी], horse gram [हुलगा], soybean [सोयाबीन], mung bean. Oilseed [तेलबिया] Crops: Mustard [मोहरी], niger seed [बियाणे], sesame [तीळ], sunflower [सुर्यफुल] etc. Vegetable Crops: Bottle gourd [दुधी भोपळा], bitter gourd [कारले], French bean, watermelon [टरबूज], cucumber [काकडी] etc.

Weed Control [तण नियंत्रण] in Previous Crop [पीक]: To control the weeds [तण] in the previous crop [पीक], spray Paraquat Gramoxone 24 S.L. this non-selective contact herbicide [संपर्क तणनाशक] 6 to 7 ml per liter of water. Spray the herbicide [तणनाशक] 4-5 days before sowing [पेरणी].
```

How to multiply Gokrupa Amrut?

Take a drum with a capacity of 200 litres and fill it with 200 litres of water. Add 1 litre of Gokrupa Amrut culture to it. Keep this drum in the shade. Take care that no garbage falls into it. Stir daily for 5 minutes in the clock wise direction with wooden stick [काठी].

(Method of making buttermilk - After making butter by adding 2 litres of water to 1 litre of curd made from Indigenous cow [गाय]'s milk [दूध], use the remaining buttermilk for Gokrupa Amrut.) For its multiplication take 1 litre of Gokrupa Amrut (as a culture), mix it with 2 kg + 2 litres of buttermilk again in 200 litres of water stir it daily for 5 minutes and use it on the seventh day.

If it is the first time, release 1000 litres of Gokrupa Amrut with water in the farm. After this, give it water at the rate of 600 litres per acre.

### **Fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] Technology for Orchards and Vegetables (Methods of Applying Soluble Fertilizers)**

Fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] is the process of giving fertilizers to crops in liquid form or soluble in water through micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] or drip irrigation system [ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली]. For delivering soluble fertilizers to crops through micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] systems, fertilizer [खत] tanks, venture, and injection pumps etc. are mainly used.

**Venturi:** The venturi is a dumb-bell shaped device with a decreasing diameter in the middle, which increases the flow rate of water and reduces the available pressure in the middle of the venture, allowing the fertilizer [खत] to be available through the manifold during irrigation [सिंचन]. Given on the ground through drips. The water in the fertilizer tank [खत साठवण टाकी] should be mixed and then the pipe coming out of that tank should be left in the venturi. After starting the drip irrigation system [ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली], if both the control valves are started, the fertilizers from the tank are absorbed/drawn through the venturi and mixed with the water flow in the pipe of the system and released through the dripper on the manifold or in the area of the roots of the trees/crops.

- **लागवडीच्या वेळी:** १ पोती युरिया, संपूर्ण स्फुरद आणि पालाश

question: हरभऱ्यामध्ये शेंडे खुडण्याचे तंत्र काय आहे?
answer:
हरभऱ्यामध्ये शेंडे खुडण्याचे तंत्र हे उत्पादन वाढीसाठी अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे आहे. शेंडे खुडणे म्हणजे हरभऱ्याच्या झाडाचा शेंडा (मुख्य वाढणारा भाग) कापणे. या पद्धतीमुळे झाडाच्या बाजूने फांद्या फुटतात आणि शेंगा वाढतात, त्यामुळे एकूण उत्पादन वाढते.

शेंडे खुडण्याचे फायदे:
- झाडाच्या बाजूने अधिक फांद्या फुटतात
- अधिक शेंगा येतात
- उत्पादन वाढते
- झाडाची वाढ चांगली होते

शेंडे खुडण्याची योग्य वेळ:
हरभऱ्याची रोपे साधारण २५-३० दिवसांची झाल्यावर शेंडा खुडावा. यामुळे झाडाची बाजूने फांद्या फुटतात आणि शेंगा वाढतात.

शेंडे खुडण्याची पद्धत:
- झाडाचा मुख्य शेंडा हाताने किंवा कात्रीने कापा
- शेंडा खुडल्यानंतर झाडाच्या बाजूने नवीन फांद्या फुटतात
- या फांद्यांवर शेंगा येतात आणि उत्पादन वाढते

A total of 671 genetic variants were identified within the ELF3 genic region, encompassing not only its genic region but also its 1 kb promoter region and intergenic regions. question: काढणीनंतर बटाट्याची सुरक्षित साठवणूक कशी करावी?
answer:
बटाट्याची काढणीनंतर सुरक्षित साठवणूक करण्यासाठी खालील महत्त्वाच्या गोष्टी लक्षात ठेवा:

**१. काढणीची योग्य वेळ:**
बटाट्याची काढणी पाने पिवळी पडू लागल्यावर करा. काढणीपूर्वी काही बटाटे कापून तपासा - जर लालसर किंवा हिरवट रंग दिसला तर बटाटे तयार झाले नाहीत.

**२. काढणीची काळजी:**
काढणी करताना बटाट्यांना इजा होऊ देऊ नका. बटाटे जमिनीतून काढताना डवरा किंवा खुरपीचा वापर करा.

**३. वाळवणे:**
काढणीनंतर बटाटे चांगल्या हवेत वाळवा. बटाटे पूर्णपणे कोरडे होईपर्यंत सावलीत ठेवा.

**४. शीतगृह साठवण:**
ताजे बटाटे शीतगृहात साठवण्यासाठी योग्य आहेत. शीतगृहात बटाटे ठेवल्यानंतर त्यांना वाफरे बनवण्यासाठी वापरण्यापूर्वी ८-१० दिवस सामान्य तापमानात ठेवा.

**५. साठवणुकीतील रोग:**
बटाट्यांच्या साठवणुकीत खुरट रोग (स्ट्रेप्टोमायस), सुका कुजवा (फ्युझेरियम) आणि लेट ब्लाइट (फायटोफ्थोरा) या रोगांचा धोका असतो. साठवणुकीपूर्वी बटाटे नीट वाळवणे आणि योग्य तापमानात ठेवणे आवश्यक आहे.

**६. वाफरे बनवण्यासाठी विशेष जाती:**
वाफरे बनवण्यासाठी चिपसोना नं. १ आणि चिपसोना नं. २ या जाती वापरा. शीतगृहात साठवलेले बटाटे वाफरे बनवण्यापूर्वी ८-१० दिवस सामान्य तापमानात ठेवा.

**७. वाफरे बनवताना:**
बटाटे पाण्यात धुवून स्वच्छ करा, यांत्रिकीद्वारे बोथट काढून घ्या आणि १ मिमी जाडीचे तुकडे करा. हे तुकडे ५% मीठाच्या द्रावणात ठेवा. त्यानंतर स्वच्छ पाण्यात धुवून तात्काळ उकडलेल्या तेलात फ्राय करा.

To prepare wafers, select fresh, white, and firm potatoes with medium and round shapes. If the potato [बटाटा] tubers have a low sugar content [साखर प्रमाण], good quality wafers can be prepared. For this, use the new varieties of potatoes specially developed for wafers, Chipsona No. 1 and Chipsona No. 2. If potatoes stored in cold storage [शीतगृह] are used, keep them at normal temperature [तापमान] for 8-10 days before making wafers.

First, wash the potatoes in water and clean them, then peel them completely with the help of a machine and make slices of 1 mm thickness using a hand machine or a chipper machine. Store these slices in a 5% salt solution [मीठाचे द्रावण]. While frying, wash these slices in clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी] and fry them immediately in boiling refined oil. If potatoes have become soft during storage [साठवण] or if the inner part has turned yellowish, immerse such potato [बटाटा] slices in a solution of 5% salt [मीठ] and 0.25% calcium [कॅल्शियम] chloride or alum for 20-30 minutes before frying. As soon as the wafers come to the surface of the oil while frying or when they are taken out of the pan, spraying [फवारणी] them immediately with 5% salt [मीठ] water produces good quality salty wafers. Besides this, wafers with different tastes and colors can be prepared by extracting the essence of different spice mixtures and spraying [फवारणी] it on them. By using different types of molds while slicing potatoes, various designs like plain or designed slices can be made to bring variety in the shape and taste [चव] of the wafers. After the wafers have cooled down, fill them in plastic bags according to market price [बाजार भाव] and demand by considering the weight. In this way, fried chips remain good in a sealed bag for approximately 15-20 days. If wafers remain in a sealed bag for a longer period, the oil in them decomposes and the wafers develop a strong rancid odor. To avoid this and to store wafers for a longer period, add 0.1% BHA (Butylated Hydroxyanisole) and 0.1% BHT (Butylated Hydroxytoluene) like antioxidants before frying the wafers. Also, while packing in bags, use an automatic sealing machine and fill the bags with nitrogen [नत्र] gas along with the wafers and seal the bags airtight. Such wafers last for 2 to 3 months.

In the first year, take Thigani (groundnut [भुईमुग]), short duration vegetables, green manure [हिवरळीची खत], or pulse [डाळ] crops. Subsequently, take a green manure crop [हिरवळीची खतपिके]. Keep the basins clean by weeding [तण काढणे] or using appropriate herbicides [तणनाशके]. Avoid intercropping [आंतरपीक] with sorghum [ज्वारी] or cotton [कापूस].

**Bahar Management [व्यवस्थापन] (Inducing Flowering):** Give stress (withholding irrigation [सिंचन]) before the Mrig/Ambiya flowering, considering the moisture content [आर्द्रता] of the soil [माती], the age of the tree, and its vigor. For the Mrig bahar, in medium soils, give 50 days of stress (April 25 to June 15) for orange [संत्री] trees, and 30 days of stress for the Ambiya bahar (December 15 to January 15).

**Ambiya Bahar:** Fruit drop [फळ गळणे] in the Ambiya bahar occurs during August to October. To reduce this, spray NAA 10 PPM (10 mg plant growth regulator [वाढ नियंत्रक] per liter of water) and 1% urea [यूरिया] (10 grams urea [यूरिया] per liter of water) every month during this period.

Do not carry out deep tillage [खोल नांगरणी] of the orchard during the fruit setting [फळधारणा] period.

**Mrig Bahar:** To reduce fruit drop [फळ गळणे] in the Mrig bahar of oranges and for increased production [उत्पादन] and economic returns, perform the first spray of 15 PPM GA-3 (Gibberellic Acid) with 15 PPM CPPU (Forchlorfenuron) or Brassinolide 2 PPM when the flowering starts, and the second spray when the fruits are pea [वाटणा]-sized.

**Applying Paste to the Trunk:** Apply Bordeaux paste (1:1:10) to the trees up to a height of 1 meter in June and October.

**Season:**

- **Ambiya Bahar Flowering:** January - February, and **Harvesting [कापणी]:** November - December
- **Mrig Bahar Flowering:** June - July, and **Harvesting [कापणी]:** February - March.Mulch the orchard to reduce fruit drop [फळ गळणे] during summer.

**Production [उत्पादन]:**

5 to 8 years: Orange [संत्री] - 150 to 400 fruits, Mosambi - 100 to 300 fruits per tree

9 years and above: Orange [संत्री] - 800 to 1000 fruits, Mosambi - 400 to 600 fruits per tree

question: हिरवळीच्या खताचा वापर करून जमिनीचा पोत कसा सुधारावा?
answer:
हिरवळीच्या खताचा वापर करून जमिनीचा पोत सुधारण्यासाठी खालील पद्धती अवलंबा:

**हिरवळीच्या खताचे फायदे:**

हिरवळीचे खत मातीत सेंद्रिय पदार्थ पुरवते, ज्यामुळे जमिनीतील जिवाणूंची कार्यक्षमता वाढते आणि जमिनीच्या भौतिक आणि रासायनिक गुणधर्मात मोठ्या प्रमाणात सुधारणा होते. हिरवळीचे खत वापरल्याने मातीचा पोत सुधारतो, पाणी धारण क्षमता वाढते आणि पिकांना आवश्यक पोषक तत्वे उपलब्ध होतात.

**हिरवळीच्या खताचे प्रकार:**

- **ढैंचा (सेस्बॅनिया)**
- **मूग (ग्रीन ग्राम)**
- **चवळी (कव्हे)**
- **गवार (क्लस्टर बीन)**
- **गिरिपुष्प**
- **करंज**
- **सुबाभळ**

**हिरवळीच्या खताचा वापर कसा करावा:**

1. **पेरणीपूर्वी लागवड:** भात पिकाच्या पुनर्लागवडीपूर्वी ढैंचा, गिरिपुष्प, टॅग इत्यादी हिरवळीच्या खतपिकांची लागवड करा. या पिकांचे फुलोऱ्याच्या टप्प्यावर ते मातीत मिसळा.
2. **चिखलणी वेळी मिसळणे:** भात पिकाच्या चिखलणी वेळी गिरिपुष्पाची पाने ३ ते ५ टन प्रति हेक्टर या प्रमाणात मातीत मिसळा.
3. **पडीक जमिनीवर लागवड:** गिरिपुष्पाचे रोपे शेताच्या कडेला किंवा पडीक जमिनीवर पावसाळ्याच्या सुरुवातीला लावा. पुनर्लागवडीच्या वेळी त्यांची पाने मातीत मिसळा.
4. **क्षारयुक्त मातीसाठी:** क्षारयुक्त मातीमध्ये हिरवळीचे खत २५ टन प्रति हेक्टर या प्रमाणात द्या.

**हिरवळीच्या खताचा परिणाम:**

- मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन वाढतो
- पाणी धारण क्षमता वाढते
- जमिनीचा पोत सुधारतो

Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]

The concept of organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] is based on originally an Indian system of agriculture [शेती]. The proof is found in the fourth-century Indian literature, "Krishiparashar", written by 'Surpal'. Till the eighteenth century, traditional farming [शेती करणे] in India was done organically. However, after the First World War, farming [शेती करणे] system started to change. After the Green Revolution [हरित क्रांती], a paradigm shift in farming [शेती करणे] system took place in it. The living world was harmed by the land. Also, the present generation has been alienated from the Indian organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] culture.

Organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] is a sustainable farming [शाश्वत शेती] method based on various elements of nature. This farming [शेती करणे] system involves long-term planning to avoid the use of expensive and harmful chemical inputs, conserve natural resources, protect the environment, and ensure human health [आरोग्य]. In this farming [शेती करणे] system, the resources available on the farm are used efficiently.

Benefits of Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]

1. By reducing production [उत्पादन] costs over time, farming [शेती करणे] can be made profitable.

- 2. By improving the texture of the soil [माती], sustainable and continuous production [उत्पादन] can be achieved.
- 3. Organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] is less expensive.
- 4. Increases the water-holding capacity [पाणी धारण क्षमता] of the soil [माती].
- 5. The pH of the soil [माती] remains balanced, the amount of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] increases in the soil [माती], and the soil [माती] becomes fertile.
- 6. The organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] system develops a management [व्यवस्थापन] system that provides the expected production [उत्पादन] without harming the environment.
- 7. The organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] system helps to maintain environmental balance and equilibrium.
- 8. The organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] system helps to maintain the balance of biodiversity [जैवविविधता].
- 9. Beneficial for the physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] and mental health [आरोग्य] of the entire living world and mankind.

**Compost [कंपोस्ट] Manures and Various Methods of Preparing Them:**

Among the various types of organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते], compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] holds a unique place. Because compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] is an excellent fertilizer [खत] made by decomposing waste materials like crop [पीक] residues, leaf litter [कचरा], animal dung [शेण], and urine [मूत्र], with the help of microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव].

Compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत], produced from plant and animal waste materials, is an important tool for increasing soil fertility [मृदा सुपीकता] and productivity. **Types of Fertilizers:**

a) **Organic Fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते]:** Fertilizers obtained from the remains of plants, animals, and microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] are called organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते]. The proportion of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] in these fertilizers is lower than in chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], hence they need to be used in much larger quantities. These fertilizers are absorbed slowly by the crops and have a favorable effect on the physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] properties of the soil [माती], improving the soil texture [जमीनीचा पोत] and increasing water retention [पाणी धारणक्षमता] capacity. Similarly, the biological properties of the soil [माती] are also improved.

**Types of Organic Fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते]:**

1. Bulk Manures: Farmyard manure [शेणखत], Compost [कंपोस्ट], and Sheep [मेंढी] manure [खत] (Lendi Khad).

3. **Green Manures:** Primarily consist of tree leaves, branches, and plant residues that are buried in the soil [माती]. Leguminous crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक] like Sesbania (Dhaincha [ढैंचा]), Black gram [उडीद] (Udid), Green gram [मूग] (Moong), Cowpea [चवळी] (Chavali), Cluster bean [गवार] (Gawar), etc., are grown in the field [शेत] and ploughed into the soil [माती] at the flowering stage. In addition, young branches and leaves of Glyricidia, Subabul [सुबाभळ], etc., are buried and decomposed in the soil [माती]. Green manures like Karanj [करंज] and Gajar Gavat (Carrot [गाजर] Grass) provide organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] to the soil [माती], increase the soil [माती]'s water retention [पाणी धारणक्षमता] capacity, and increase the availability of plant-nourishing nutrients [पोषक तत्वे].

b) Green Manures

Diagnosis [निदान]

Vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव] should be suspected when any litters are born dead or weak, as also when abnormalities of the eyes [डोळे] are present in newborn piglets. If the litters of young pigs are very susceptible to enteritis and pneumonia, or if paralysis of the hindquarters is often seen in pigs in the piggery, then it is necessary to check if there is enough green feed/fodder [चारा] or vitamin A in the diet.

Enteritis, pneumonia and paralysis are not necessarily caused by vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव]. A common disease [रोग] causing a similar birth of dead piglets is leptospirosis [लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस]. In this disease [रोग], the infected sow [मादी डुक्कर] does not show any obvious symptom [लक्षण] until she aborts, which may occur two to four weeks before farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] takes place. If the sow [मादी डुक्कर] farrows at full time, the piglets are born dead or weak. For diagnosis [निदान] of hypovitaminosis A, testing of sow [मादी डुक्कर]'s blood [रक्त] serum [सिरम] is essential.

Treatment [उपचार] and control

When there are obvious symptoms [लक्षणे] of vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव], a dose [मात्रा] of 10 000 IU of the vitamin A supplement should be given as a drench. Pigs suffering from vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव] will usually respond very quickly when the vitamin is supplied in adequate amounts, but animals with advanced symptoms [लक्षणे] such as marked muscular incoordination or blindness seldom recover completely.

Control

To prevent the occurrence of vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव], good quality fresh green feed should be provided daily, or a vitamin A supplement added to the feed. About 60 g of green feed should be provided to each pig [वराह] daily. Whole milk [दूध] has fairly large amounts of vitamin A, but skim milk [स्किम्ड दूध] is a very poor source as are most milk [दूध] products, meat [मांस] meal [जेवण] and grain [धान्य] (except maize [मका] which is very high in carotene). Cod liver oil and fish [मासे] oils contain large amounts of vitamin A and can be used as supplements, but it is easier and cheaper to use one of the commercial synthetic stabilized vitamin A supplements. These can be obtained in powder or liquid emulsion form for mixing with the feed; details about the quantities to be fed are supplied with the various preparations. Many commercial preparations contain vitamin A together with vitamin D.

6.3.6 Goose stepping (Pantothenic acid deficiency)

Definition and etiology [रोगकारण]

Pantothenic acid, also known as vitamin B5, is essential for normal physiological functions in pigs. It plays an important role in the synthesis and metabolism of carbohydrates, proteins and fats. Deficiency of this vitamin can lead to a variety of clinical symptoms [लक्षणे], particularly affecting growing pigs and pregnant sows.

Inadequate dietary intake of pantothenic acid, particularly in growing pigs and pregnant sows, lead to the development of deficiency symptoms [लक्षणे]. Lowquality or improperly formulated feeds may lack sufficient levels of essential vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] and minerals [खनिजे], including pantothenic acid. Any concurrent gastrointestinal disease [रोग]/problems that affect the absorption of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] from the gastrointestinal tract can also contribute to deficiencies.

Clinical signs

Clinical signs include loss of appetite [भूक कमी होणे], leading to significant weight loss [वजन कमी होणे] and poor growth [वाढ] rates. Goose-stepping gait is a distinctive, exaggerated high-stepping style of walking [चालणे], primarily affecting the hind limbs, that is commonly observed in pigs with this deficiency. It results from nerve damage and muscle weakness [दुर्बलता], resulting in a lack of muscle coordination leading to an unsteady and staggering walk. Non-infectious bloody diarrhoea [अतिसार] in few cases is also reported. In severe deficiency, death may occur as a result of complete anorexia.

Diagnosis [निदान]

Diagnosis [निदान] of deficiency cannot always be made based only on response to nutritional therapy, particularly if it is a long-term deficiency. A nutritional deficiency needs to be diagnosed based on several factors such as clinical signs, dietary review, presence of diseases and management [व्यवस्थापन] history.

question: प्रति हेक्टरी किती झिंक सल्फेट वापरावे?
answer:
प्रति हेक्टरी झिंक सल्फेट वापरण्याचे प्रमाण हे पिकावर आणि झिंकच्या कमतरतेच्या प्रमाणावर अवलंबून असते. खालील प्रमाणे वापर करता येते:

**१. खत म्हणून मातीत देणे:**
- **१५ किलो प्रति हेक्टरी** - ज्वारी, तूर, मूग आणि इतर डाळी पिकांसाठी झिंक सल्फेट पेरणीच्या वेळी शिफारस केलेल्या खतासोबत द्यावे.
- **१० किलो प्रति हेक्टरी** - रजनीगंध पिकासाठी शिफारस केलेल्या खतासोबत द्यावे.

**२. पानांवर फवारणी:**
- **०.५ ते १.० टक्के द्रावण** - झिंक सल्फेटचे द्रावण तयार करून पानांवर फवारणी करावी. हे झिंकच्या कमतरतेच्या लक्षणांसाठी उपयुक्त आहे.

**३. फळबागांसाठी:**
- **१२५ किलो प्रति हेक्टरी** - आंबा आणि मृग बहार फळबागांसाठी दोन वेळा विभागून द्यावे (फुलोऱ्याच्या वेळी आणि फळधारणेच्या वेळी).

**महत्त्वाचे:**
- झिंकची कमतरता असल्यास खत म्हणून मातीत देणे अधिक परिणामकारक आहे.
- फवारणीसाठी नेहमी शिफारस केलेल्या प्रमाणातच द्रावण तयार करावे.

question: जमिनीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढवण्यासाठी सेंद्रिय मार्ग सुचवा.
answer:
जमिनीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढवण्यासाठी खालील सेंद्रिय मार्ग वापरा:

**१. सेंद्रिय खतांचा वापर करा:**
शेणखत, कंपोस्ट खत, गांडूळखत यांचा नियमित वापर करा. यामुळे मातीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढतो आणि मातीची सुपीकता सुधारते.

**२. पीक अवशेष जाळू नका:**
पीक अवशेष (पीकाच्या १/३ भाग) जाळून टाकू नका, ते मातीत गाडून ठेवा. यामुळे सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढतो.

**३. आच्छादन पद्धत वापरा:**
ऊसाचा कचरा किंवा गव्हाचा काड जमिनीवर आच्छादनासाठी वापरा. यामुळे मातीतील ओलावा टिकून राहतो आणि सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढतो.

**४. हिरवळीची खतपिके लावा:**
ढैंचा, गिरीपुष्प, ग्लायरीसिडिया यांसारखी हिरवळीची खतपिके लावा आणि मातीत गाडून ठेवा. यामुळे मातीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढतो आणि नत्र देखील वाढतो.

**५. डाळींची पिके आंतरपीक पद्धतीत घ्या:**
डाळींची पिके आंतरपीक पद्धतीत घ्या. यामुळे मातीतील नत्र वाढतो आणि सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढतो.

**६. ट्रायकोडर्मा बुरशी वापरा:**
पीक अवशेषांचे विघटन वेगाने होण्यासाठी ट्रायकोडर्मा बुरशी वापरा.

**७. जमिनीची मशागत कमी करा:**
जमिनीची मशागत कमी करा आणि समतलीकरण करा. यामुळे मातीची धूप कमी होते आणि सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढतो.

**८. पशुधनाचे व्यवस्थापन करा:**
शेतीत पशुधनाचे व्यवस्थापन करा. शेणखत आणि कोंबडी खत यांचा वापर केल्याने सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढतो.

**९. वारा थांबवणारे अडथळे लावा:**
शेताच्या कडेला वारा थांबवणारे अडथळे आणि हिरवळीची खतपिके लावा. यामुळे मातीची धूप कमी होते आणि सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढतो.

**१०. पीक फेरपालट करा:**
वेगवेगळ्या कुटुंबातील पिकांची फेरपालट करा. यामुळे मातीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढतो आणि रोग-किडींचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो.

question: शेतीत जीवामृताचा वापर करण्याचे फायदे काय आहेत?
answer:
जीवामृताचा वापर करण्याचे अनेक फायदे आहेत:

**जीवामृत म्हणजे काय?**
जीवामृत हे एक सेंद्रिय द्रव खत आहे जे गायीच्या शेण, मूत्र, गूळ, हरभरा पीठ आणि माती यांचे मिश्रण करून तयार केले जाते. हे सेंद्रिय शेतीत अत्यंत उपयुक्त आहे.

**जीवामृताचे फायदे:**

१. **पोषक तत्वांची उपलब्धता वाढते:** जीवामृतामुळे पिकांना आवश्यक पोषक तत्वे योग्य प्रमाणात उपलब्ध होतात.

२. **मातीतील उपयुक्त जिवाणू वाढतात:** जीवामृतामुळे मातीतील उपयुक्त जिवाणूंची संख्या वाढते, ज्यामुळे मातीची सुपीकता सुधारते.

३. **पीक वाढीस चालना मिळते:** जीवामृत हे पीक वाढीस चालना देणारे पदार्थ आहे.

४. **उत्पादन खर्च कमी होतो:** घरच्या घरी तयार केलेले शेण आणि बेसन वापरल्यामुळे उत्पादन खर्च कमी होतो आणि उत्पन्न वाढते.

५. **मातीचा पोत सुधारतो:** जीवामृताचा वापर केल्याने मातीचा पोत सुधारतो आणि आर्थिक फायदे मिळतात.

**जीवामृत कसे तयार करावे?**
१० किलो गायीचे शेण, १० लिटर गायीचे मूत्र, २ किलो गूळ, २ किलो हरभरा पीठ आणि १ किलो माती २०० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून ५-७ दिवस रोज ३ वेळा ढवळावे. हे मिश्रण १ एकर क्षेत्रात पाण्यातून द्यावे.

answer:
तेलबिया पिकांना स्फुरद (फॉस्फरस) देण्यासाठी खालील पद्धती वापरा:

**१. बियाणे प्रक्रिया:**
स्फुरद विरघळविणारे जिवाणू (PSB) खत वापरा. बियाण्यावर २५ ग्रॅम प्रति किलो बियाणे लावा. हे जिवाणू जमिनीतील अघुलनशील स्फुरद घुलनशील स्वरूपात रूपांतरित करतात आणि पिकांना उपलब्ध करून देतात.

**२. रासायनिक खते:**
तेलबिया पिकांसाठी सिंगल सुपर फॉस्फेट (एसएसपी) किंवा डाय-अमोनियम फॉस्फेट (डीएपी) वापरा. हे खत पूर्णपणे विरघळणारी खते आहेत आणि स्फुरद उपलब्ध करून देण्यास मदत करतात.

**३. खतांचे प्रमाण:**
- **करडई (सफ्लॉवर):** १० किलो स्फुरद (६२.४ किलो एसएसपी) प्रति एकर द्या. पेरणीच्या वेळी दोन टिन्स बियाणे पेरणी यंत्राद्वारे द्या.
- **इतर तेलबिया पिके:** पिकानुसार स्फुरदाचे प्रमाण बदलते, परंतु सामान्यतः १०-१५ किलो स्फुरद प्रति एकर द्यावे.

**४. एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन:**
रासायनिक खतांबरोबर सेंद्रिय खत (शेणखत, कंपोस्ट) आणि हिरवळीची खतपिके वापरा. हिरवळीची खतपिके जमिनीत गाडून द्या जेणेकरून सेंद्रिय पदार्थ वाढेल.

**५. जिवाणू खताचा फायदा:**
स्फुरद विरघळविणारे जिवाणू खत वापरल्याने बियाणे अंकुरण क्षमता वाढते, मुळांची वाढ जोरात होते, जमिनीतील पोषक तत्वे उपलब्ध करून देण्याची क्षमता वाढते आणि पिकाचे उत्पादन १०-१५ टक्क्यांनी वाढते.

**काळजी:**
- जिवाणू खताची बाटली सूर्यप्रकाश आणि उष्णतेपासून दूर ठेवा.

4.Potassium [पालाश]:

Potassium [पालाश] is the third most abundant mineral in the animal body and serves as the primary intracellular ion, with concentrations ranging from 100 to 160 mmol/L in body tissues. It plays a crucial role in maintaining nerve and muscle excitability, as well as regulating the body's water balance [जल संतुलन] and acid-base equilibrium. Potassium [पालाश] is also involved in cellular respiration [श्वसन] through the chloride shift and influences various intracellular processes, including enzyme function and muscle contraction.

For herbivores, potassium [पालाश] deficiency is uncommon, as most forages naturally contain adequate levels of this mineral. However, when deficiency does occur, it can lead to symptoms [लक्षणे] such as muscle weakness [दुर्बलता], stiffness, paralysis, and intracellular acidosis. In potassium [पालाश]-deficient animals, the reduction of potassium [पालाश] in milk [दूध] is more pronounced than in plasma [प्लाझ्मा]. Depending on the extent of the disease [रोग] condition, intravenous isotonic 1.3-1.4 % solution of sodium bicarbonate solution is given as treatment [उपचार].

Alkalosis

Elevated blood [रक्त] pH is the hallmark of alkalemia, also known as metabolic alkalosis, which is often driven on by excessive acid loss, increased absorption of alkali, or a carbon dioxide deficiency.

Etiology [रोगकारण]

Metabolic alkalosis commonly arises from condition like abomasal atony, which may occur due to abomasal impaction. Under these events, potassium [पालाश] and hydrochloric acid are continuously secreted into the abomasum, resulting in hyperchloremic and hypokalaemia alkalosis. Furthermore, metabolic alkalosis can cause a shift in potassium [पालाश] from extracellular to intracellular locations, which may exacerbate hypokalaemia even in cases where the body potassium [पालाश] levels are acceptable.

Clinical signs

Animal alkalosis may be challenging to diagnose due to a lack of specific clinical symptoms [लक्षणे]. It frequently causes convulsions, tetany, tremors in the muscles, and shallow respirations. In more severe phases, dyspnoea and hyperpnea can appear.

Treatment [उपचार]

Treating alkalosis in animals involves fluid therapy with 0.9% isotonic saline along with electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] management [व्यवस्थापन], including giving potassium [पालाश] chloride (KCl) at 20-40 mEq/L IV, are crucial.

The etiologies of electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] imbalance include vomiting, burn exudation, sweating, and excessive salivation. २. **कापूस पिकासाठी:** जैविक कापसासाठी आणि जमिनीच्या आरोग्यासाठी पेरणीपूर्वी १००% नत्र खताची मात्रा गांडूळखताद्वारे (६ टन/हेक्टर) द्यावी किंवा ३३% कंपोस्ट (४ टन/हेक्टर) + ३३% गांडूळखत (२ टन/हेक्टर) + ३३% निंबोळी पेंडी (५७२ किलो/हेक्टर) द्यावी.

question: ठिबक सिंचनाद्वारे सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये देण्याची सर्वोत्तम पद्धत कोणती?
answer:
ठिबक सिंचनाद्वारे सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये देण्याची सर्वोत्तम पद्धत म्हणजे **सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे (फर्टिगेशन)** आहे. यामध्ये ठिबक सिंचनाद्वारे खत आणि पाणी एकत्रितपणे पिकांना दिले जाते. यासाठी खालील महत्त्वाच्या गोष्टींची काळजी घ्यावी:

**फर्टिगेशनचे फायदे:**
- पाण्याची बचत होते आणि उत्पादनात वाढ होते
- खताचा कार्यक्षम वापर होतो
- खत मुळांच्या जवळ पोहोचते
- वेळेवर आणि योग्य प्रमाणात खत देता येते

**सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये देण्याच्या पद्धती:**

**१. फवारणीद्वारे (स्प्रे):**
- झिंक, लोह, मॅंगनीज, बोरॉन यांसारखी सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये फवारणीद्वारे देणे अधिक प्रभावी ठरते

**Injection Pump**

In this method, fuel, electrical energy, or water pressure is used to inject fertilizer [खत] into the main line. These pumps are expensive. Therefore, injection pumps of this type are generally used when fertilizers are being applied in greenhouses. Similarly, such pumps are prepared using corrosion-resistant materials like plastic or fiber when the area under drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] is large, or the parts coming into contact with fertilizer [खत]-mixed water are coated with such materials.

**Precautions to be Taken During Fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे]**

1. Drip emitters/drippers should be placed properly on the soil [माती].
2. Care should be taken to prevent soil [माती] or leaf litter [कचरा] from entering the drip emitters/drippers.
3. Fertilizers, algae, sulfur, iron [लोह], or other salts should not be allowed to accumulate in the drip/micro-irrigation system [सूक्ष्म सिंचन प्रणाली], as this can clog the emitters/drippers. If algae are present, chlorine treatment [उपचार] should be done, and if chemical impurities are present, acid treatment [उपचार] should be done.
4. When applying solid fertilizers with water, it is essential that they are completely water-soluble.
5. If the fertilizer [खत] chemically reacts with salts or other chemicals in the water, gypsum [जिप्सम] is formed from calcium [कॅल्शियम] and sulfate, which clogs the system (drip emitters/emitters, sub-mains). In such cases, the system should be cleaned by acid treatment [उपचार].
6. The system used for fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] should be easy to use. All equipment can be used only if the system is well-designed and provides standard pressure.
7. Manganese [मॅंगनीज] oxide, which is reddish/black in color, is formed due to bacteria [जीवाणू]. Also, a white precipitate is formed in the drippers due to the chemical reaction of salts present in the water with calcium [कॅल्शियम]/magnesium.

**Measures for Vegetable Crops in Drought [दुष्काळ] Conditions**

In drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, good market prices are obtained for vegetable crops and farmers get good benefits as vegetable cultivation is very limited due to adverse climate [हवामान] (high temperature [तापमान] and dry [कोरडे] hot air) and water scarcity [पाण्याची कमतरता]. For this, it is important to select the right vegetable crop [पीक] and get quality production [उत्पादन] from it. It is difficult to grow vegetable crops in drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, but some measures can be taken to use less water, e.g. to cultivate some vegetables by using drip and sprinkler irrigation [तुषार सिंचन]. Some important measures for this are as follows.

1. Selecting vegetable crops that require less water e.g. drumstick, hadga, guar and leafy vegetables.
2. Use of soil [माती] cover.
3. Onion [कांदा] Nursery [रोपवाटिका] Management [व्यवस्थापन].

- Onion [कांदा] crop [पीक] nursery [रोपवाटिका] should be prepared on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] should be done before sowing [पेरणी] onion [कांदा] seeds.
- Do not use too much chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Water the nursery [रोपवाटिका] before sowing [पेरणी] the seeds and sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds.
- Sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds thinly and then use a sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन] or rain gun.
- Use shed [निवारा] net on the nursery [रोपवाटिका] if possible.

1. To protect against dry [कोरडे] and hot winds, drumstick crop [पीक] or dense planting of maize [मका] should be done on all four sides of the field [शेत] or around the wind [वारा].
2. Water management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन] through micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] methods (drip or sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन]).
3. Proper balance of chemical and organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते].
4. Selecting varieties with more leaves and protecting flowers and fruits from heat through them.
5. Use of growth [वाढ] regulators (NAA 20 PPM and Boron [बोरॉन] 20 PPM) in flowering and use of transpiration [बाष्पोत्सर्जन] inhibitors on leaves.
6. Integrated management [व्यवस्थापन] of biological and chemical drugs for the protection of diseases and pests from nursery [रोपवाटिका] to fruiting.
7. To reduce the intensity of heat, use a porous plastic mesh (shed [निवारा] net).
8. Proper use of available water - especially ensure even water supply during flowering to fruit harvesting [कापणी] period and that too in the morning, morning or evening and at night (avoid watering in the hot sun).
9. Harvest [कापणी] the fruits preferably in the evening and transport the goods (in the morning) after grading [गटवारी] packaging [पॅकेजिंग].  
    By using the above points in a planned and integrated manner, it will be possible to achieve excellent quality of summer vegetables and to obtain higher yields and summer vegetable cultivation will be more profitable due to the combination of the quality and yield [उत्पादन] of the produce.
